summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Highway Pilot Stage 1 MVP (marketing site + Fleet Command Center + Driver PWA). Backend: 26/26 tests passing (100%). Frontend: Core flows working with 1 critical UI bug (Emergent badge overlay blocking driver PWA navigation).

fixed_bugs.issue: MongoDB ObjectId serialization error on POST endpoints
fixed_bugs.fix: Added serialize_doc() to all POST endpoint responses to remove _id field

fixed_bugs.error: Empty string email field fails EmailStr validation
fixed_bugs.fix: Added field_validator to convert empty strings to None for optional fields

critical_bugs.issue: Emergent badge overlay blocks clicks on bottom nav tabs (Truck, Settings)

critical: Fix Emergent badge overlay blocking driver PWA bottom navigation. The badge is intercepting pointer events on tabs. Solution: adjust z-index or position of badge, or add pointer-events: none to badge container.
verification: Test driver PWA navigation to Truck and Settings tabs after fixing overlay issue
Verify all 4 bottom nav tabs (Home, Trips, Truck, Settings) are clickable on mobile viewport
